City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 2018 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation for Kayakers and Certificate of Bravery for Keane Hayes
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 14, 2018 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2018-11-28 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-11-28 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Authorization to upgrade Microsoft Operating System (OS) and Office products. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Approve upgrading Microsoft Operating Systems and Office applications and authorize the implementation of Option 1; 2) Authorize participation in Microsoft Enterprise Agreement for State and Local Governments for the period of January 1, 2019 through December 30, 2021; and authorize anticipated renewal of the Microsoft Enterprise Agreement from January 1, 2022 through December 30, 2025; 3) Authorize Windows operating system annual support in an amount of $23,739 in FY 2018-19; and authorize anticipated annual support renewals in amounts of $23,739 in FY 2019-20; $23,739 in FY 2020-21; $24,925 in FY 2021-22; and $26,171 in FY 2022-23 using Microsoft Enterprise Agreement for State and Local Governments; and 4) Authorize Office 365 Pro Plus subscriptions in an amount of $41,040 in FY 2018-19; and authorize anticipated Office 365 subscriptions in amounts of $41,040 in FY 2019-20;$54,720 in FY 2020-21; $57,456 in FY 2021-22; and $60,328 in FY 2022-23 using Microsoft 365 for U.S. Government pricing which was competitively bid.
2018-11-28 Item 08C Upgrading Microsoft Operating System and Office Products
8D.
Consideration of the extension of the existing Right of Entry and License Agreement and Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA) on the Pacific View Property. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a one-year extension, in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, to the existing Right of Entry and License Agreement between the City and the EACEA; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached one-year Exclusive Negotiating Agreement, in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, with the EACEA .
2018-11-28 Item 08D Right of Entry with EACEA
8E.
VMWare software license annual support renewals. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Authorize VMWare license annual support renewals with Nth Generation in an amount not to exceed $17,541 in FY 2018-19, and authorize anticipated VMWare license annual support renewals in amounts not to exceed $25,000 in FY 2019-20; and $25,000 in FY 2020-21 in conjunction with the City Attorney.
2018-11-28 Item 08E VMWare Renewal
8F.
Whale Tail Grant from the California Coastal Commission. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Supervisor Burritt
1) Approve a Resolution authorizing an application for grant funds from the Whale Tail Grants Program from the California Coastal Commission; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with the California Coastal Commission, in conjunction with the City Attorney, subject to future City Council budget appropriations.
2018-11-28 Item 08F Whale Tail Grant
8G.
Recreational Trails Naming. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Approve the proposed names for Recreational Trails within the City of Encinitas.
2018-11-28 Item 08G Trail Naming
8H.
Contract for Engineering and Construction Private Development Inspection Services. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa’u
1) Authorize the City Manager, or the City Manager’s designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an extension to the existing contract with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation for engineering inspection services related to private land development projects in substantial form, in an amount not to exceed $899,688 for FY 2018-19, $917,681 for FY 2019-20, and $936,035 for FY 2020-21, for a three-year term, with options to extend, upon mutual consent, for two additional one-year terms in an amount not to exceed $954,756 for FY 2021-22, and $973,851 for FY 2022-2023; and not to exceed five years total and a total contract cost not to exceed $4,682,011; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-92 approving an off-cycle appropriation to the FY 2018-19 operating budget of $375,247 in the Development Services Department.
2018-11-28 Item 08H Infrastructure Engineering Corporation Private Development Engineering and Construction Inspection Services
8I.
Right of Entry Agreement and Memorandum of Understanding between the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) and the City. Contact Person: Public Works Director Quiram
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign the Right of Entry Agreement in substantial form between the City and SEJPA; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form for Laboratory Space between the City and SEJPA.
2018-11-28 Item 08I SEJPA Agreements
8J.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2018-16, to adopt modifications suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-05, which amended the General Plan, North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan to clarify provisions for roadway improvements on North Coast Highway 101. CASE NO: 10-036 GPA/SPA/LCPA/EIR. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
1) Conduct the public hearing; and 2) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2018-16 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Modifications Suggested by the California Coastal Commission to City Council Ordinance No. 2018-05, which Adopted Amendments to the Local Coastal Plan, North 101 Corridor Specific Plan and the General Plan to clarify provisions for roadway improvements on North Coast Highway 101."
2018-11-28 Item 08J Second Reading Streetscape California Coastal Commission Modifications
8K.
Proposed personnel changes and approval of the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District Pay Range Table and Position Titles. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
1) Adopt Resolution 2018-96 titled “A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Approving Personnel Changes and the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District Pay Range Table and Position Titles”; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2018-101 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.”
2018-11-28 Item 08K Proposed Personnel Changes and Approval of City of Encinitas and San Dieguito Water District Pay Range Table and Position Titles
8L.
Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2017-18. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Approve and adopt the actual ending fund balances for FY 2017-18 as beginning fund balances for FY 2018-19; 2) Approve the revised Schedule A, "Revised Budget Summary FY 2018-19"; 3) Receive Capital Improvement Program End of Year Status Report; and 4) Adopt Resolution 2018-95 authorizing a: a) Lump sum payment to CalPERS to reduce the City of Encinitas unfunded pension liability in the amount of $218,495, which is 5% of the remaining FY 2017-18 General Fund budget carryover of $4,369,893; and b) Fund balance transfer in the amount of $500,000 from the remaining General Fund carryover to the Open Space Acquisition Fund.
2018-11-28 Item 08L FY 2017-18 Year End Results
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Amendment No. 2 to City Manager’s Employment Agreement. Contact Person: Mayor Blakespear and Deputy Mayor Mosca
1) Approve Amendment No. 2 to the City Manager’s Employment Agreement to include an increase in the annual base compensation by $7,283 for a total of $250,043; an annual City contribution toward City Manager’s selected 457-Deferred Compensation Plan in the amount of $20,000; and an additional nine (9) hours of vacation leave annually, effective June 1, 2018; and 2) Approve a Budget adjustment of $27,283 to the City Manager department budget for FY18/19.
2018-11-28 Item 10A Amendment 2 to City Manager's Employment Agreement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
City Attorney update on legal challenges to Costa Mesa Sober Living Home Ordinance. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
2018-11-28 Item 11A Costa Mesa Sober Living

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 12, 2018
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
